question: Which Union Territory had minimum literacy rate as per 2011 Census?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Dadra and Nagar Haveli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dadra and Nagar Haveli** had the **minimum literacy rate**2011 Census of India.
 
• The literacy rate recorded for Dadra and Nagar Haveli was **76.2%**, significantly lower compared to other Union Territories.
 
• The region is primarily inhabited by tribal communities, which contribute to challenges in achieving higher literacy levels.
